response.sql: SELECT SUM(rebtotal) AS total_rebate, AVG(feerate - rebrate) AS avg_net_fee_rate FROM fees WHERE rebrate > 0.0005;

assumptions.assumption: "Average net fee rate" is the mean of the per-row difference feerate - rebrate over the qualifying rows. Rows with a NULL feerate are skipped by AVG, and rows with a NULL rebrate fail the filter. Rows with a NULL rebtotal are skipped by SUM. Both aggregates return NULL when nothing qualifies, which matches the request's empty-value rule.
